summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory and then invokes it to execute `math_init.js`, a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle shipped in the package. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling (`_0xNNNN` names and a dictionary lookup used even for trivial strings like `bun`, `bun.exe`, `--version`, `ldd`, `musl`), and `math_init.js` is a minified bundle built around a shuffled numeric/string dispatch array with no readable purpose. The advertised library surface, `lib/index.js`, is an ~15-line Babel preset function with no relation to Bun or to the bundle. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute a large opaque payload unrelated to the package's stated Babel-preset purpose runs automatically on every `npm install`, and the bundle's contents are not inspectable from the Node ecosystem's normal tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
